title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned the Data Room. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Data Room
options.thesis: The brief as a file in a cabinet that changes its whole colour with the weather: every week a folder, every area a document, the record an index.
options.viewport: Folder tree left, the week's file open in the centre, scores as index cards right; the folder tint and paper ground shift with the condition.
options.risk: Reads as a file manager, not a brief, if the document does not lead.

raised.raise: Numbered step numerals: the brief's sections carry large step numbers as wayfinding.
Visible construction grid: the page's grid is a real armature, not hidden.
Guide words: the first and last item in view name the span you are inside.
Link-line state: standing carries through stroke pattern, not hue.
Snap-to-pitch: the record's week scrub snaps to month pitch.

options.label: Investor Update
options.lineage: weekly investor updates and board letters
options.thesis: The week's guidance as an investor update whose header, accent and paper shift with the weather.
options.viewport: A letter with a weather-tinted header, sections for each area, and scores in the margin.
options.risk: Also the direction most runs in this category land on: reads as an email template if the weather shift is timid.

options.label: Alphabet Storm
options.thesis: Letters condense into the week's weather: words break into rain and reshape the guidance on the page.
options.viewport: One monumental grotesk that gathers into CLOUD, breaks into rain, and carves the week's call across the page.
options.case: Fuses on the user's weather steer: the whole page is weather by construction. Loses on clarity, since letter-as-weather can obscure the data and the five areas.
options.risk: Reads as a poster, not a brief, if the typography performs instead of informing.

options.label: Brick Instructions
options.thesis: The week as a build sheet: numbered steps, a stud grid, and a 1:1 call-out for each new part.
options.viewport: Numbered spreads in sequence, a parts inventory up front, call-outs zooming the pieces a step introduces.
options.case: Fuses poorly: the founder does not identify with a toy manual, and a build sequence misrepresents a brief.
options.kept: Numbered step numerals and a visible stud grid as the page's armature.

options.label: Crouwel Grid
options.thesis: Letterforms built cell by cell on a visible construction grid, the poster as the proof.
options.viewport: Monumental grid-constructed letterforms over small neutral grotesk, the grid visible as part of the design.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a specimen is a specimen, and monumental letters crowd out the brief.
options.kept: A visible construction grid as the page's literal armature.

options.label: Lexicon Page
options.thesis: Black text to a fixed measure, a shoulder margin, guide words naming the span in view.
options.viewport: A spread with guide words at the head and a bordered plate carrying the foreign colour.
options.case: Fuses poorly: scholarly apparatus is not the founder's world, and colour quarantined in plates fights condition-driven theming.
options.kept: Guide words and bordered plates for foreign media.

options.label: Jackfield Schedule
options.thesis: Numbered lanes on black glass, each item tied to its default by an amber link line.
options.viewport: An endless lane grid under a fixed legend strip, link lines drawn by stroke pattern.
options.case: Fuses poorly: audio engineering is not the founder's world, and amber-on-black fights a condition-driven palette.
options.kept: Link-line state marks and lane numbers as durable anchors.

options.label: Cutting Bench
options.lineage: film editing benches and select rails
options.thesis: The weeks as frames on a select rail: scrub, flag where you stopped, trims hang below.
options.viewport: A perforated rail of weeks across the top, the current frame open below.
options.case: Fuses poorly: film editing is not the founder's world, and a fixed orange accent fights condition-driven theming.
options.kept: A perforated rail that snaps to pitch and a folded flag where you stopped.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What a documentation-grade weekly brief ships, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: The arrangement a visitor expects, at full craft: nav, hero, sections, footer.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
